# skill-loader

> Zero-dependency Python loader that detects and parses Claude Code skills (SKILL.md, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) into JSON so they can be reused in OpenClaw. Codex and Gemini CLI support is planned.

## What it does
- Detects the skill format of a directory, parses name, description, triggers and instruction content, and prints JSON.
- Read-only: it never modifies the original skill files.
- Pure Python standard library, single file `loader.py`.

## Supported formats
- Claude Code single skill: `.claude-plugin/SKILL.md` (preferred) or root `SKILL.md`
- Claude Code marketplace: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, either an explicit `skills` array or auto-discovery of `skills/*/SKILL.md`
- Codex (`codex.json`) and Gemini CLI (`skill.yaml`): detected only, loading is planned (raises "not implemented")

## Install
git clone https://github.com/ythx-101/skill-loader.git

## Usage
- `export SKILL_LOADER_DIR=/path/to/skills` (default: /root/clawd/skills)
- `python3 skill-loader/loader.py scan` lists detected skills by type
- `python3 skill-loader/loader.py load /path/to/skill` prints the parsed skill as JSON
- `python3 skill-loader/loader.py find "text"` returns the first skill whose trigger appears in the text
- `SKILL_LOADER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` disables the daily update check (interactive terminals only)

## Python usage
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/path/to/skill-loader")
from loader import SkillLoader
skill = SkillLoader("/path/to/skills").load_skill("/path/to/skills/some-skill")

## Limitations
- No tool-call mapping yet (planned); no Codex / Gemini CLI loading yet (planned).
- Frontmatter parsing is simple single-line `key: value`, not full YAML.
- Triggers are extracted only from description text like: Triggers on "a", "b".
